hints.title: Point Ranking
hints.text: Compute total points as wins times three plus draws. Rank teams descending using standard competition ranking with rank window function.

hints.title: Total Teams Counting Window
hints.text: Obtain total team count using count window function without partition to calculate relative tier thresholds.

hints.title: Ceiling Percentage Tiers
hints.text: Apply case conditions comparing position against ceil(total_teams * 0.33) for Tier 1 and ceil(total_teams * 0.66) for Tier 2.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH RankedTeams AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        team_name,
        wins * 3 + draws * 1 AS points,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wins * 3 + draws * 1 DESC) AS position,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_teams
    FROM TeamStats
)
SELECT
    team_id,
    team_name,
    points,
    position,
    CASE
        WHEN position <= CEIL(total_teams * 0.33) THEN 'Tier 1'
        WHEN position <= CEIL(total_teams * 0.66) THEN 'Tier 2'
        ELSE 'Tier 3'
    END AS tier
FROM RankedTeams
ORDER BY points DESC, team_name ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Sorting by points and window rank plus count calculation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Subqueries per row for count and rank cause quadratic overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies analytic window functions for rank and count with conditional tier classification.
